Package io.github.lorenzobettini.emfmodelgenerator

Class EMFResourceHelper

java.lang.Object
io.github.lorenzobettini.emfmodelgenerator.EMFResourceHelper
public final class EMFResourceHelper extends Object
Helper class for managing EMF resources in a given ResourceSet, including resource creation with proper naming schemes and output directory management.

      public void setFileExtensionForEClass(org.eclipse.emf.ecore.EClass eClass, String extension)

    • setFileExtensionForEPackage

      public void setFileExtensionForEPackage(org.eclipse.emf.ecore.EPackage ePackage, String extension)
      Set a custom file extension for all EClasses in a specific EPackage. This takes precedence over the global extension but is overridden by EClass-specific extensions.
      Parameters:
      ePackage - the EPackage
      extension - the file extension (without the dot)

    • createResource

      public org.eclipse.emf.ecore.resource.Resource createResource(org.eclipse.emf.ecore.EClass eClass)
      Create a new Resource in the ResourceSet with a file URI based on the EClass. The file name follows the pattern: {packageName}_{className}_{counter}.xmi
      Parameters:
      eClass - the EClass for which to create a resource
      Returns:
      the created Resource

    • generateFileName

      public String generateFileName(org.eclipse.emf.ecore.EPackage ePackage, org.eclipse.emf.ecore.EClass eClass)
      Generate a file name for the given EClass following the naming convention. Pattern: {filePrefix}{packageName}_{className}_{counter}.{extension} The extension is determined using hierarchical lookup: EClass -> EPackage -> global -> default.
      Parameters:
      ePackage - the EPackage
      eClass - the EClass
      Returns:
      the generated file name

    • createFileURI

      public org.eclipse.emf.common.util.URI createFileURI(String fileName)
      Create a file URI for the given file name in the output directory. The path is normalized to avoid "." and ".." segments and converted to an absolute path.
      Parameters:
      fileName - the file name (including extension)
      Returns:
      the file URI
